## Type Aliases

### WaitlistStatus

```ts
type WaitlistStatus = "waiting" | "admitted" | "declined" | "joined";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/waitlist-rules.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/waitlist-rules.ts)

Where an entry stands: waiting for a wave, admitted (it holds a ticket), declined, or joined (it became an account).

***

### WaitlistStep

```ts
type WaitlistStep = "join" | "verify" | "status";
```

Defined in: [src/runtime/vue/composables/use-waitlist.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/runtime/vue/composables/use-waitlist.ts)

Where a person is in joining: asking for the code, entering it, or reading their place.

## Functions

### useWaitlist()

```ts
function useWaitlist(options?): UseWaitlistReturn;
```

Defined in: [src/runtime/vue/composables/use-waitlist.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/runtime/vue/composables/use-waitlist.ts)

Join the waitlist, and read a place in it, on markup of your own: the
steps `<WaitlistForm>` runs. `join` checks your questions' answers and the
bot check, then asks for a sign-in code; `verify` checks the code (the
double opt-in) and answers the person's place; `status` follows a place by
its status link; `leave` removes the entry. Steps never reject: a failure
is in `error`, with `retryAfter` for a rate limit.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `options?` | [`UseWaitlistOptions`](#usewaitlistoptions) |

#### Returns

[`UseWaitlistReturn`](#usewaitlistreturn)

#### Example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const { step, bind, join, verify, place, error } = useWaitlist()
</script>
<template>
  <form v-if="step === 'join'" @submit.prevent="join">
    <input v-bind="bind.emailInput">
    <button>Join</button>
  </form>
  <form v-else-if="step === 'verify'" @submit.prevent="verify">
    <input v-bind="bind.codeInput">
    <button>Confirm</button>
  </form>
  <p v-else-if="place">You're #{{ place.position }} of {{ place.total }}</p>
</template>
```
